messages:
sasha: :rotating_light: paging — GPU queue spiking, autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes. Observed: queue length up x6 in last 10m, pods Pending with NodeAffinity/taint issues. autoscaler logs show launch-template mismatch + assume-role failures.

oncall-bot: Incident page created: INC-2034109876. Paging oncall: @maria. Severity: P1 — customer-facing latency increases on hosted API.

maria: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking ASG history. which region?

sasha: us-west-2. affected pool: gpu-pool-prod-1. traffic spike from batch embed jobs. early signal ~2034109000.

aj: looking at cluster-autoscaler logs:
```
I1027 18:27:03 autoscaler.go:xxx] ScaleUp: No scale-up performed: failed to launch nodegroup gpu-pool-prod-1: LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch
E1027 18:27:04 aws_manager.go:yyy] error assuming role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/AutoscalerRole: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole
```

aj: also seeing taint errors in scheduler: pods pending with tolerations missing for node.kubernetes.io/gpu. But the main root: autoscaler couldn't provision due to LT version mismatch and IAM deny.

maria: checking ASG activity: several attempt launches 18:26-18:31, instances terminated immediately with exit reason "LaunchTemplate version 5 not found". I can temporarily bump launch template default version to 6 (safe change?) — need infra approval.

noah: if we change LT default we risk drifting infra config. Alternative: manual provision of a warm node group (existing LT v6) and add to k8s. we can also fallback traffic to dedicated capacity for top customers.

infra-bot: terraform plan shows drift: aws_autoscaling_group.gpu_pool uses launch_template_id = lt-0abcde, launch_template_version = "${var.template_version}" (var currently 5). Current latest LT version = 6.

maria: ok small mitigation plan: 1) temporarily allow ASG to use latest LT by changing template_version -> "$Default" (manual patch via console), 2) update IAM policy to let autoscaler assume role (sts:AssumeRole on role/AutoscalerRole), 3) drain low-priority jobs from queue. Any objections?

aj: +1 for patching IAM first. if autoscaler still can't assume role it'll keep failing even with LT fix. I can push an IAM inline policy change (needs approval).

ops-bot: Audit: 3 customers currently seeing >5s request tail latency on embeddings. Customer IDs: c-1345, c-9901, c-2345. Fallback routes available to dedicated clusters for c-1345 and c-9901. c-2345 is on shared hosted only.

sasha: tagging support: @oncall-support please notify affected customers with ETA ~30-45m while we fix capacity. mention degraded throughput and potential rate limiting.

maria: I executed a minimal IAM patch to allow sts:AssumeRole for AutoscalerRole on the cluster's account (rolled as emergency change). Confirming now.

aj: IAM change applied, verified with sts:AssumeRole call successful from autoscaler pod: 
```
$ aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456:role/AutoscalerRole --role-session-name test
{ "Credentials": { ... } }
```

aj: autoscaler picked up change and retried scale-up. new attempt shows: 
```
I1027 18:34:10 autoscaler.go:xxx] Attempting to launch nodegroup gpu-pool-prod-1 version 6
I1027 18:34:15 aws_manager.go:zzz] Launch successful: instance i-0fabc123
```

maria: launching manual node from LT v6 as a warm helper while we confirm autoscaler health. provisioning...

infra-bot: Manual instance i-0fabc123 joined cluster-nodes, labeled gpu=true. taint applied: node.kubernetes.io/gpu:NoSchedule.

aj: scheduler still showing some pods pending because they don't have toleration for node.kubernetes.io/gpu. looks like a few older jobs missing toleration. I'll patch the DaemonSet that injects tolerations for batch jobs.

sasha: quick patch applied to batch-job controller to add toleration. redeploying rollout.

aj: rollout done. pending pods are now scheduling onto new node. queue length dropping.

ops-bot: Customer impact update: tail latency for embeddings back to baseline for c-1345 and c-9901. c-2345 still seeing occasional retries but queue drained from ~1200 -> ~180 in 22m.

maria: mitigation summary so far: IAM assume-role fixed (hotpatch), manual warm node added (LT v6), controller toleration patch to allow scheduling. Next: reconcile terraform to make LT version consistent and create a followup CR to avoid template drift.

noah: I'm taking the handoff for next 2 hours to watch for regressions. @maria please open postmortem ticket and include timeline + customers impacted. I'll coordinate with infra to schedule a safe terraform apply to update launch_template var to 6 and run plan in staging first.

sasha: thanks all. tagging post-incident severity: P1 -> degraded but mitigated. moving thread to monitoring channel after handoff. :thumbsup:

maria: created postmortem draft: PM-2034109876 in Jira. putting root cause as launch-template version drift + insufficient IAM scope for autoscaler + missing tolerations on some batch pods. action items: terraform reconcile, tighten CI for LT version bump, add autoscaler assume-role unit test, add alert for "LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch" in autoscaler logs.

oncall-bot: Handoff complete. Next oncall: @noah. Incident status: mitigated — monitoring.

sasha: marking thread resolved for pager duty, will update incident doc once no regressions after 1h. :white_check_mark:
